payload.body: Three answers. (1) YOUR TURN for the records now, by land-close.sh: vc checked them at HEAD 3f0791ee, the 14 paths of ready-records.txt (31a5bd69), all changed, change c8eac1876fd3a41647e0d99c783c8f57e72e55039b9fde17365b1850de4c210c, index empty. AC .5, .7 and .9 read as asked. Send vc the sha. (2) The code: ic/stb8e4fb6 at 72591d09, one commit on 03191d0d, which is on main; change 305f791046db15cbbc2ccaa9f5626fed94407d5f32cb487edc440a1ebaa8e802 over its 7 paths; no Python; the unreadable warning in cc's words, with NotFound still silent. The driver, run-qr.sh 326a7b1e, read in full, is SOUND: HEAD pinned, a clean tree, CARGO_TARGET_DIR unset, the whole run's process group killed at 3600 s, and every step's exit in the one log. vc takes step 1, cargo test --release -p showreel, as devbin's declared rust command narrowed to the one crate the change touches, since prez does not depend on showreel and AT09's clippy compiles the workspace. The log's change line is a --binary hash, so the END compares HEAD, not that line, with the READY. (3) GO: ask the Desk for the cargo lane, naming run-qr.sh's sha and 72591d09. Say in the one line of text that it does not run alongside utilz-cc's spike ask TM15WA and goes after its END. The Desk is closed until hv gives devbin-vc a word, so it queues behind dc's ask. Wake devbin-vc. The END gives each step's exit and its counts from the log: cargo's test result lines, qr.sh's passed, failed and skipped, and AT09's line, each skip named. dc reads the code second now, while its own run waits on the Desk.
